description: Run one ad on one channel, under a spend cap the owner has named out loud. The cap is debited before anything is created and nothing is ever created above it. Creative is the owner's: this never writes an ad. Needs a connected ad account.

cap_minor.description: The total spend cap in MINOR units (kobo, cents). Required, never inferred: this is the number the owner approved.

daily_budget_minor.description: Daily budget in minor units. Defaults to the cap.

image_url.description: A public image the ad platform can fetch.

name: launch_ad_plan
